subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: What degraded-state contract should Gateway expose during startup, reload, and restart draining so Control UI and `sessions.resolve` do not present missing-session errors while runtime state is not trustworthy?
rationale: The issue is valid enough to keep open, but the durable fix requires choosing API/UX behavior across readiness probes, WebSocket method gating, Control UI messaging, session recovery, and launchd restart recovery.

options.title: Shared degraded-state contract
options.body: Make Gateway readiness/reload state the source of truth for Control UI and session RPCs, then land focused fixes such as the WebChat notice path under that contract.

options.title: Narrow WebChat recovery first
options.body: Review the open WebChat notice PR as a limited improvement while leaving the broader partial-reload contract on this issue.

options.title: Operator-guidance only
options.body: Treat live plugin/config maintenance as unsupported operational practice and document the safer workflow, accepting that Control UI may still show generic failures.

recommendation.title: Shared degraded-state contract
recommendation.body: Make Gateway readiness/reload state the source of truth for Control UI and session RPCs, then land focused fixes such as the WebChat notice path under that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant recent history crosses Gateway startup sidecars, hot reload, method descriptors, and Control UI-facing runtime behavior.
